name: Top Bar
description: Custom menu bar with hover-based dropdown menus. File menu (Open Workspace, Exit), View menu with nested submenus for Terminal (dynamic instances with focus/reopen), Explorer (singleton, like Git), Git (singleton), Markdown (singleton), Canvas grid style (dots/grid/none with check marks), Zoom (in/out/reset/lock). Help menu (Tutorial, About). Theme toggle button (◐). Rendered into the #menu-bar element. Full re-render on any state change (plugin lists, grid style, zoom lock). Hover-based 300ms close timer for menus.
